notes.title: 大家的反馈我们听到了！
notes.notes:
感谢这么多年来大家还记得这个游戏。

重大更新以后收到红字评价，制作组已经深刻意识到，这次确实是一厢情愿地闭门造车了。


主创炒饭已经在B站进行了一场马拉松式直播，了解到了自己的创作和玩家的期待之间的差距。

DLC里包含的短篇剧情，【不是官方指定结局】，只是炒饭对故事走向的某一种解读。

但做为一个多结局的游戏，追加该DLC短篇时【并未考虑到玩家的自由选择权和代入感】，

也没有回应玩家的期待，很显然是非常欠考虑的行为。

这个十周年的约定，是我们失约了，辜负了大家的信任。TvT

其他的不多说，既然大家不满意，我们就【改】！



接下来制作组打算进行一次免费的内容更新，包括本体和DLC，添加更多的后续。

每个玩家都有自己心中【高恋结局】，希望未来的更新能补完这些缺憾。



目前我们已经下架了所有与此DLC相关的捆绑包，并在更新完成之前不推荐大家购买。

已经购买的玩家，也可以通过Steam的后台进行退款。

如果出现问题，或有想看到哪些后续内容的想法，请在B站联系我们，联系方式在公告的下面。

最后再次向大家道歉！请再给我们一点时间！

notes.title: HD Remaster!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8866545/8bc4e3624e1487538695fb8f4b727d88db26f136.png[/img]

Hello, fellow alumni!

Ten years ago today, *Gaokao.Love.100Days* was officially released on Steam.

We still remember the chaos back then—rushed testing, last-minute changes, and even struggling to find the publish button in the Steam backend due to our inexperience.

But in the end, we managed to pull it off, against all odds.

It was a big step for Class Tangerine & NVLMaker, and perhaps… a small step for Chinese Gal Game!

Thanks to your continued support, we're incredibly lucky and grateful to still be making indie games ten years later.

Now, for everyone attending this alumni gathering, we'd like to show you some of our recent progress:

**HD Remaster of the Game!**

We’ve updated the engine and upgraded the resolution from the original 1024x768 to full HD 1920x1080.

Naturally, this means the game now requires more disk space (from 2GB → to 8GB), so please make sure to reserve enough space when updating.

The HD version can inherit CGs, endings, and collected items from the previous version. If you have any save files that haven’t reached an ending yet, we recommend finishing them in the old version before switching.

Instructions on how to switch back to the previous version are provided below and are also available on the new version’s launch screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8866545/76996420c1937c9af00fb436bcacebeedd822afc.png[/img]

notes.title: Revised English Subtitle & "War Within Pilgrimagers"[Update 655423]
notes.notes:
[h1]Bug Fix[/h1]

Item "War Within Pilgrimagers" now can be successfully acquired at END 41.

If you have unlocked END 41 before, please check the ending in the end-list and get the item to unlock the achievement.

修复“真·西游杀”无法获得的问题，现在可以在结局41获得此道具。假如之前已经解锁过结局41，请在结局列表里重温，即可获得道具（解锁成就）~

[h1]Revised English Subtitle[/h1]

Many thanks to our proofreaders, a better English version is online now!

英文校正版上线，各位校对君辛苦了！

[h1]Savedata error after update (can be fixed manually)[/h1]

Since there are lots of changes in the English subtitle, part of the save data could become invalid after the new update. (English Language Only).

It will only affect the data saved during events. The data saved at “Night Class Mode” and “Weekend Free Mode” will remain the same. The CGs/Endings/Achievements/Items will also work as usual. 

[b]The save data can be fixed and then be used in the new version after the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/347620/discussions/0/598198173700400399/]following steps[/url].[/b]

We are sorry for the inconvenient. ːmuxinː

notes.title: Revised English Subtitle Planning
notes.notes:
We are aware of the translation issue and started a proofreading plan right after the initial release. The Revised version (with minor bug fix) will be published in one week.

Many thanks to Matt! It’s really great to have a native speaker helping us!

Since we’ll publish lots of changes in the English subtitle, part of the save data could become invalid after the new update. (English Language Only)

It will only affect the data saved during events. The data saved at “Night Class Mode” and “Weekend Free Mode” will remain the same. The CGs/Endings/Achievements/Items will also work as usual.

[b]It’s highly recommended to save your latest progress at ‘Night Class Mode’ before the game closed. [/b]

But don’t worry too much. We will also release an optional patch with the update. [u]You could still use your old save data by applying the patch manually. [/u]

notes.title: Language Setting & Save Data|设置语言与存档
notes.notes:
[h1]English Player[/h1]

<Gaokao.Love.100Days> will be released in English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese. The default language setting is English, so if you are an English player, just click start and enjoy the game.

Save data will bind to language setting, which means the data saved in English can only be load in English setting.

If you switch to other languages and can not find the save data, don't panic, they are still there.. ːdogeː

[h1]中文玩家[/h1]

《高考·恋爱·一百天》包含简繁中文和英文，在进行游戏前，请在STEAM客户端内修改语言设置。

如下图，在游戏名字上按右键，选择“属性”。
[img]http://i257.photobucket.com/albums/hh217/countd2005/gaokao100/step1.png[/img]

之后点击“语言”标签，从下拉菜单里选择您想使用的语言。
[img]http://i257.photobucket.com/albums/hh217/countd2005/gaokao100/step2.png[/img]

游戏的存档是与语言设置绑定的，也就是说在特定语言下保存的档案也只能在对应语言下读取。

当切换到其他语言时，存档并没有丢失，只是被从列表中隐藏了，请不要担心~ːmuxinː
